title: Conf1igure Single Sign-On (SSO)
overview: Single Sign-On (SSO) enables users to authenticate once and securely access multiple applications without re-entering credentials.
prerequisites: Metadata XML file from the IdP

procedure.instruction: Navigate to Administration > Security > Single Sign-On.
Upload the Identity Provider metadata XML file.
Verify the Entity ID and Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL.
Perform a test login using an SSO-enabled user account.

validation: Users can authenticate through the Identity Provider.
Application dashboard loads successfully after login.
notes: Configuration changes may take up to five minutes to propagate.
Keep a backup of the previous authentication configuration.
warnings: Incorrect IdP metadata can prevent all users from logging in.
Test the configuration before enabling SSO for all users.

troubleshooting.issue: Login fails after SSO is enabled.
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify that the Entity ID and ACS URL match the values configured in the Identity Provider.
Confirm that the signing certificate has not expired.
